paper_equations.wake: Eqs. 1-6: three-dimensional Gaussian wake, atmospheric log law, and linear local-inlet deficit superposition
paper_equations.intermittency: Eqs. 21-22: stationary Markov wind probabilities and thresholded expected absolute power transition
paper_equations.optimization: Eqs. 23-26: reciprocal mean-power and intermittency minimization with square and greater-than-3D spacing constraints
paper_equations.algorithm: Eqs. 27-28 and Section 3.3: real-coded NSGA-III with uniform reference lines

paper_fixed_controls.turbine: Vestas V112, D=112 m, hub=84 m, rated=3 MW
paper_fixed_controls.farm: 25 turbines in [0,20D] by [0,20D], spacing greater than 3D
paper_fixed_controls.convergence: relative hypervolume change below 0.01 percent after more than 1000 iterations

missing_information: author in-house source and random states
machine-readable 144-state wind rose and Markov matrices
machine-readable V112 power and thrust curves and rotor quadrature
R1 and R2 random laws and polynomial mutation distribution index
hypervolume reference point and maximum non-convergence stopping limit
repeat count, raw fronts, and optimized coordinates

wind.transition: reversible local speed and periodic direction Metropolis kernels whose stationary distribution exactly equals the declared wind rose; direction proposal scale 24.8 degrees
wind.claim: figure-constrained deterministic reconstruction, not original Marado arrays

algorithm.crossover: Eq. 27 with independent uniform R1 per coordinate
algorithm.mutation: bounded Deb polynomial mutation with index 20 and probability 1/50 per coordinate
algorithm.repair: deterministic clamp and pair-spacing repair with reference-lattice fallback

mathematical_reformulations: wind geometry sorted once per direction and reused over nine speeds
sparse reversible Markov transitions replace dense zero-negligible entries
turbine curves, rotor quadrature, transition weights, and reference lines are immutable
outer candidate parallelism avoids nested oversubscription
counter-keyed random events and fixed reductions preserve one/all-core scientific identity
hpc.formal_resource_rule: one process owns all twenty Waffle cores; six cases and 25 seeds execute sequentially

claim_boundary: Academic flexible paper-equation and figure-constrained reconstruction of target NSGA-III and all six paper optimization cases; not author code, original Marado data, private arrays, random states, or numerical replay.
